review_notes: I read the whole file. It adds no new structure, class or def. Its only additions are local notations (m, n, e, B, T, S, P, N), private lemmas, and the public lemmas `one_le_norm_A_of_ne_zero`, `exists_ne_zero_int_vec_norm_le` and its primed variant. The local notations are just abbreviations for existing Mathlib objects: Fintype.card, Finset.Icc on Pi types, posPart/negPart, and the sup norm from Matrix.seminormedAddCommGroup. The sup norm is used as the existing Mathlib instance, not redefined. `one_le_norm_A_of_ne_zero` and the main theorems are theorem-level statements, so duplication there falls outside this rubric. I found no competing definition of a concept already in Mathlib. I did not search the Mathlib source exhaustively for every possible near-duplicate lemma, but those would be standalone theorem duplicates anyway.
